notes.Scope: 2026 revised Round 1 (28 October) vs provisional Round 2 (20 November). Default AIR 61,347; R1 state rank 2,091, R2 state rank 2,193.
notes.Matching: Exact NEET-PG AIR within the same exam year; unique within each round and cross-checked against registration ID. Every shared candidate has the same registration ID.
notes.State order: Before the target candidate’s round-specific state merit position: 2,090 -> 2,192; 102 additions, zero removals and zero retained candidates crossing the threshold.
notes.AIR threshold: Strictly better AIR (<61,347), regardless of bonus: 1,766 -> 1,854; 88 additions and zero removals. Target excluded.
notes.In-service bonus: 14 new candidates have worse AIR than 61,347 but are ahead in the state list due to bonus marks. Count them in state-order analysis, not better-AIR analysis.
notes.Whole lists: All 3,165 Round 1 candidates remain listed. Round 2 adds 248 candidates for 3,413 total. These lists do not establish who joined, withdrew, is eligible for a particular pool or will fill choices.
notes.Interpretation: An absence is only absence from the compared list, not proof of withdrawal. A new row is newly listed, not necessarily newly registered. Domicile does not establish seat eligibility.
notes.Domicile: Not Applicable remains a separate group and is excluded from All Except Rajasthan. Rajasthan candidates may also compete for private-college AI seats.
notes.Privacy: Derived files omit names, relatives, gender and NEET roll numbers. Public Board PDFs are retained unchanged as sources.
notes.Rank change: A higher state-rank number indicates a later list position. Do not compare the same numeric state-rank cutoff across rounds to track one candidate.
notes.Provenance: Supplied Round 2 PDF verified byte-for-byte against https://pg.neetrajasthan.com/notifications/1795180258933.pdf on 20 November 2026.
